question: In the following question, select the odd letter/letters from the given alternatives.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• First and second letters → Difference between the position values according to English alphabetic series is (2).
 
• Third and fourth letters → Opposite letters according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 
• RPMN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61675e04b277ad362681751c4dd1112c0275e483065234ad85d93f602f59a4dd.png] 

 
• HFCX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/032e42effb9cd5934ab3cda5822f017a35d79c32fe0af244f0013af3f4a60fdd.png] 

 
• LJGT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/325ecdba7fcb8f0d2cbf270482bebfaa09a7729cb11a2791991d46de8e5f85d8.png] 

 
• MKHG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fc263f3ccf16dd814813faa6210c85d472ce4679f39e5e2497a15ee8050ceec.png] 

Thus, out of all options only **'****MKHG**' doesn't follows the same logic as others.

Hence, the correct answer is "**MKHG****"**.
